h: Macron reportedly postpones his 28 October visit to Nigeria
p: French President Emmanuel Macron has reportedly postponed a planned trip to Nigeria that was due on 28 October. No new date has been given in the reports seen so far, and neither government has detailed the reason.
more: The visit had been billed as a state-level engagement.
Officials have not announced a new date.
The Presidency has not commented publicly.
